title: Greenhouse Physics-Guided Forecasting under Structural Uncertainty: Reproducibility Package
description: Code, processed v3 data, model-evaluation outputs, and reproducibility materials for greenhouse microclimate forecasting experiments using recurrent neural networks, coarse-grained thermal physics diagnostics, gradient-conflict analysis, NASA POWER boundary-forcing stress tests, and multi-seed statistical evaluation. The canonical NASA POWER point is 40.54°N, 81.30°E (Alar, Xinjiang, China).
notes: All NASA-dependent v2 outputs produced with 37.2944°N, 79.8547°E are obsolete. The final v3 analysis uses 40.54°N, 81.30°E and an empirically supported logger-clock alignment of UTC+6 h. The UTC+6 convention is not a civil-timezone assertion.
